reviews.review:
Let me start off, this game is fantastic in a way that makes me drawn to it, in a way that... alright let me be more honest here..
i played the first one, that's why I'm here. I liked the first one a lot so it's good maybe just fine thumbs up.
I have a decent mid to high end computer and this game doesn't run worth a ♥♥♥♥.
so far its good, i think starting out on nightmare was a bad idea haha

It starts off fun and there is a ton of replay-ability and deep dive content, even more than the first one..... BUT, its just to hide the poor design and crap mechanics. The elites and boss are some of the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ designed fights I have ever fought in 3+ decades of gaming. True Souls games have easier bosses and better mechanics than this game. ♥♥♥♥, ill take Radahn again please pre nerf for every fight and the ♥♥♥♥ would be better. BS damage checks, stupid mechanics to 2 tap you through MAX Armor & DR and so many stagger locks. So much aoe ♥♥♥♥ on the ground you cant even see the next attack and enemies that just "appear" in locations behind you after you have cleared everything mid fight to shank you in the back to then chain lock and kill you. Unless you exploit something in the game you basically HAVE to run their infinite stamina dodge everything build or die play style, IF you can find the ring. There is no real experimentation, just bad damage. Leveling takes forever and the random runs make trying to force a build almost impossible. Killing bosses even in "Normal" mode takes friggen forever when trying to level something to then go back to "max" difficulty content as you basically just get murked without max class damage. I just cant do this anymore and am killing the game at 90% achievement completion. (85 Hours)
There were a few really good fights, but most should just be a straight punch to the designers nuts. Please do NOT do this ♥♥♥♥ in Remnant 3. Go back to first game boss/elite design but keep the immersion and expanse of 2.
